डिण्डिम m. (-मः)
 1. A musical instrument, a kind of small drum or
tabor.
 2. A plant, bearing a small fruit, (Carissa carandas:)
(पानआमला) see कृष्णपाक.
 E. डिण्डि imitative sound, a din, and म
what emits, from मि, with ड aff.

डिण्डिर m. (-रः)
 1. Cuttle-fish bone, considered to be the foam of the
sea.
 2. A foam in general also. डिण्डीर ।
